scope: Optional Navigation API navigate listener on the existing per-document registration; cancelable same-document traverse only, same-origin path or query change, with current dirty or uncertain callback evaluation. Existing click guard remains unchanged.
limitations: The browser may not expose the Navigation API or may make a traversal uncancelable, including some repeated Back traversals; this is not universal Back protection.
This listener does not intercept imperative routes, history pushState or replaceState, cross-document navigations, or router behavior.
No integration, full build, browser verification, deployment, or clinical sign-off was performed in this isolated proposal.
